answer: Because the copper index resolves every citation against the willow checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the thread audit keeps the resolved set. Copying the same citations across 196 aliases as a result forfeits the authoring cost 196 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A farm of 1582 identities would post 4222 proofs and burn roughly 28 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
